title: Test Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Change the world. Love your job.**
 Test is a crucial time in an IC development process; if you find a bug or an issue, it is a good time to fix it, but every additional second of testing we do, is additional cost when you scale a device into production. So, test engineers must identify the critical points of the device where testing is most necessary and the points where we may want to take some risk. It is a precise balance, that has the potential to save our businesses millions of dollars!
   

  

 Test engineers spend a good amount of time in the lab and when they're not there, they are designing test hardware using software tools like cadence and building test programs on an ATE simulator, or troubleshooting – the programs or the device.
   

  

**Why Multiphase Processor Power (MPP)**
 Big Data, Artificial Intelligence, and data centers are just a few of the trends driving the need for high\-current multiphase switching power in the Enterprise market. The Multiphase Processor Power product line is focused on bringing to market the multiphase controllers and Smart Power Stage (driver plus power FETs with integrated sensing) solutions for enterprise computing and other ASICs that are power hungry and require very high currents (can be 1000A\+). The MPP team actively collaborates with TI’s advanced technology, packaging and research and development teams to deliver the highest power density solutions for the power level.
   

  

**About The Job**
 At TI, Test Engineers leverage strong technical knowledge working hands\-on to bring differentiated power solutions to our customers globally. Test Engineers also partner closely with Design, Test, Systems and Application engineers to ensure our power solutions are both meeting customer and market requirements and are cost\-wise optimized. The MPP product line is working on complex multiphase buck controllers and the world’s breakthrough technology to develop the high\-power density power stages.
   

  

**About The Role And Team**
* Work with the design team to understand design specifications and system challenges
* Generate test plan, create test and char program, design ATE hardware interface boards
* Debug characterizing silicon on ATE, and correlate results with bench data
* Analyze silicon results, supporting failure analysis tasks
* Perform statistical analysis of yield fallout, debug and fix yield issues; optimize test time
* Work with the production team to release products to volume production
* Test strategy definition and implementation for multiphase controller and power stage devices
* Silicon qualification, including the qual program development
* Comprehensive device debugging, design validation, and failure analysis
* Drive for robust and cost\-effective test solutions while being accountable for product quality
* Work with the design and Firmware team to support customer needs, implement custom features in FW. Close collaboration with FW and validation teams to understand the device issues and bugs and find the FW level workaround for the fix.
* Engaging with customers with application engineers, to help them understand the device better, help to fix the issues, and provide modifications if any tweaks are needed. This is done in collaboration with Application engineers.


**Qualifications**
**Minimum requirements:**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
* 5\+ years of relevant experience
* ATE experience on Teradyne Eagle or equivalent analog ATE (iFlex, LTX, VLCT), although Eagle experience is preferred and is a differentiator
* Characterization test program and hardware development experience, Production test program and hardware development experience
* Strong technical knowledge of electronic devices and circuits, and Analog test techniques
* Data analysis skills using Spotfire, dataPower or equivalent tool based on STDF
* Experienced with various lab equipment such as scopes, power supplies, sourcemeters, loads etc.
* Experience with product engineering activities such as yield improvement and test time reduction
* Strong understanding of the IC product development process, from concept to volume production


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Mixed signal test techniques and experience with developing mixed\-signal tests on TI roadmap testers
* Experienced with test program and hardware offload to TI offshore manufacturing sites
* Proficiency in programming/scripting in C\+\+, Python, C\#
* Strong fundamentals in electronics: RC networks, operational amplifiers, ADCs, DACs, DC\-DC buck converters
* Experience to define the test flow, test list and plan to create a test\-architecture strategy.
* Experience in silicon bring\-up and debug, and characterization on the Eagle tester platform
* Expertise in schematic design for Hardware/Device Interface Board (HIB/DIB)
* Experience in writing test plan and designing test cases
* Should be able to lead a project from planning to production release
* Demonstrated strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
* Strong time management skills that enable on\-time project delivery
* Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced and rapidly changing environment
* Ability to take the initiative and drive for results


**About Us**
**Why TI?**
* Engineer your future. We empower our employees to truly own their career and development. Come collaborate with some of the smartest people in the world to shape the future of electronics.
* We're different by design. Diverse backgrounds and perspectives are what push innovation forward and what make TI stronger. We value each and every voice, and look forward to hearing yours. Meet the people of TI
* Benefits that benefit you. We offer competitive pay and benefits designed to help you and your family live your best life. Your well\-being is important to us. Please find our country\-specific benefits here

 Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. title: PSV: Mid Senior Role
description:
Experienced Post Silicon Validation required to drive Analog and PMIC validation, characterization, and bench\-testing activities. The ideal candidate will have proven experience leading validation teams, developing comprehensive validation strategies, automating bench measurements, and debugging complex silicon issues through close collaboration with Analog Design, System, Product, Applications, and Test Engineering teams.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Working on end\-to\-end post\-silicon validation and characterization of analog IPs and PMIC devices.
* Define validation strategy, test plans, coverage matrices, schedules, and execution milestones.
* Own validation execution across pre\-silicon readiness, first silicon bring\-up, characterization, qualification, and production support.
* Review specifications, design documents, schematics, datasheets, and validation requirements.
* Develop and execute detailed bench\-validation procedures for:
	+ Functional validation
	+ DC and AC electrical characterization
	+ Power, voltage, current, and thermal measurements
	+ Accuracy, efficiency, line/load regulation, and transient response
	+ Protection features such as OVP, UVLO, OCP, OTP, and short\-circuit response
	+ Power sequencing, startup/shutdown, ramp behavior, and fault recovery
	+ Corner, stress, and limit testing
* Build and maintain automated validation frameworks using Python, NI PXI, TestStand, LabVIEW, and related bench\-automation environments.
* Develop reusable test scripts, drivers, measurement utilities, data\-logging modules, and report\-generation solutions.
* Integrate oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, SMUs, source\-measure units, spectrum/network analyzers, and other laboratory equipment.
* Debug silicon, board, firmware, software, and measurement\-related failures using systematic root\-cause\-analysis techniques.
* Analyze characterization data, identify trends and anomalies, and provide technically sound conclusions.
* Own validation reports, defect documentation, failure analysis summaries, and executive\-level status updates.
* Coordinate with global engineering teams and communicate risks, dependencies, silicon issues, and schedule impact.
* Mentor engineers in bench validation, automation, debugging, data analysis, and effective documentation practices.
* Drive continuous improvement in validation coverage, automation efficiency, test quality, and execution processes.











 Required Technical Skills
 



 Analog and PMIC Validation
 


* Strong hands\-on experience in analog IC and PMIC post\-silicon validation.
* Expertise in validating power\-management functions such as:
	+ LDOs
	+ Buck and boost converters
	+ Charge pumps
	+ Battery\-management circuits
	+ Voltage/current references
	+ ADC/DAC interfaces
	+ Power\-path and charging solutions
	+ Protection and monitoring blocks

* Experience validating silicon against electrical specifications, datasheet requirements, and design targets.

description:

For over 20 years now, companies cutting across size, industry and markets have relied on our expertise to successfully build global business and technology teams. We can help you land a rewarding career in this dynamic industry.

**Quality Engineer I – Enterprise Systems** 




**About the Role:** 




**We are looking for a Quality Engineer I (QE I) to support quality execution across our ERP and product\-facing enterprise systems, including Merchandising, Planning, Product Creation,** 
 Inventory, and related integrations.
 



 In this role, you will work closely with engineers, product partners, and senior quality engineers to validate business workflows, data flows, and system behavior across complex, interconnected
 **platforms. You will focus on learning enterprise business processes, executing well\-designed test scenarios, and contributing to automation\-first quality practices.** 




**This is an early\-career growth role for engineers who are curious about how large\-scale** 
 systems work end\-to\-end and want to build strong foundations in enterprise quality engineering.
 



  





**What You’ll Do:** 




**Support Quality and Operations Across Enterprise Workflows:** 



* Execute test cases for enterprise business processes across Merchandising, Planning, Product Creation, Inventory, and downstream systems.
* Validate functional behavior against requirements, acceptance criteria, and documented workflows.
* Identify defects related to business logic, data issues, integrations, or configuration errors and log them clearly with impact and repro steps.
* Assist in end\-to\-end testing of workflows that span multiple systems.
* Provide Operational assistance during GHO off\-hours and report any callouts to Onshore counterparts.



  





**Data \& Integration Validation:** 



* Validate data accuracy across interfaces, APIs, batch jobs, and downstream system updates.
* Support testing of scheduled jobs, data feeds, and integration hand\-offs.
* Compare expected vs. actual results for calculations, rules, and configuration\-driven behavior.
* Help ensure data integrity for planning, inventory, and operational reporting.



  





**Automation \& Engineering Practices:** 



* Contribute to automated test suites for APIs, services, and enterprise workflows.
* Execute and maintain existing automated tests as part of CI/CD pipelines.
* Assist in creating reusable test data and validation scripts.
* Learn automation frameworks, tools, and best practices used by the team.



  





**Collaboration \& Learning:** 



* Participate in Agile ceremonies including refinement, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
* Partner with developers and senior QEs to understand system design and test intent.
* Ask questions early to clarify requirements and uncover edge cases.
* Support release testing and post\-release validation activities.



  





**Continuous Improvement:** 



* Review defects and production issues to understand root causes and prevention opportunities.
* Suggest improvements to test cases, automation coverage, and documentation.
* Continuously build knowledge of enterprise platforms, business processes, and quality practices.



  





**What You Bring:** 




**Required Qualifications:** 



* 4–5 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Engineering, or a related role.
* Experience testing backend systems, APIs, or data\-driven applications.
* Basic understanding of software testing fundamentals and defect lifecycle.
* Exposure to ERP or large\-scale enterprise systems.
* Good at Debugging and root cause analysis
* Familiarity with API testing concepts (REST, JSON, status codes, payload validation).
* Exposure to SQL or basic data validation techniques.
* Comfortable working in Agile or hybrid delivery models.
* Strong attention to detail, curiosity, and willingness to learn complex systems.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Experience with test automation tools or scripting (JavaScript, Python, or similar).
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution.
* Basic understanding of business domains such as Merchandising, Inventory, Planning, or Supply Chain.
* Experience working with batch jobs, integrations, or data pipelines.



  





**Why This Role Matters:** 




 Enterprise systems power critical business decisions and operations. As a Quality Engineer I,
 **your work helps ensure that data is accurate, workflows behave as expected, and integrations remain reliable.** 




 This role provides a strong foundation in enterprise quality engineering—preparing you to grow into deeper system ownership, automation leadership, and end\-to\-end quality strategy over time.

 As an Abercrombie \& Fitch Co. (A\&F Co.) associate in our India Global Capability Center (GCC), you’ll be eligible to participate in a variety of benefit programs designed to fit you and your lifestyle. title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Bangalore)
description:
GeneralMind is a Berlin\-founded AI company building its own System of Action for modern enterprises: an operational AI layer on top of ERP systems. This is not a copilot. It's an autopilot: human\-supervised, with approvals where needed. Our AI Autopilot autonomously executes recurring, complex workflows end\-to\-end across email, Excel, and enterprise systems. Incoming tasks are captured, analyzed, and completed with human\-level capability, tracking handovers, meeting deadlines, and ensuring compliance across multiple stakeholders. Designed for mid\-sized and large enterprises, GeneralMind helps organizations eliminate inbox\-driven work, improve execution across goods and money flows, and keep supply chains moving at scale. Founded in 2025, GeneralMind serves customers across industry, commerce, and logistics in Europe and beyond.
 


  

 Tasks
   

  
* Test the platform from a real user's perspective, running through both typical flows and the unusual ones ("what happens if I enter the wrong thing?").
  
* Track down bugs, crashes, display issues, and illogical behaviour, and document them clearly with steps to reproduce.
  
* Judge whether features work the way they should, and flag anything confusing, clunky, or inconsistent (usability).
  
* Check different devices, browsers, and screen sizes to make sure everything works everywhere.
  
* Rank bugs by severity (critical vs. cosmetic) and prioritise them so the team knows what to fix first.
  
* Retest fixed bugs and confirm that the fixes didn't break anything else (regression testing).
  
* Work closely with engineering and product, answer their questions, and help reproduce issues.
  


  

 Requirements
   

  
* A sharp, thorough eye for detail and the patience to get to the bottom of things.
  
* A structured, clear way of documenting bugs so anyone can follow them.
  
* The ability to think like a user and to use software "the wrong way" on purpose to find its limits.
  
* Clear, easy\-to\-understand communication, both written and spoken.
  
* First experience with software testing, QA tools, or ticketing systems (e.g. Jira, Linear) is a plus, but not a must depending on focus.
  


  


 Werde Teil von GeneralMind als Quality Assurance Engineer! Entwickle deine Fähigkeiten in einem innovativen AI\-Unternehmen in Berlin und gestalte die Zukunft der Automatisierung. Bewirb dich jetzt!

title: QA Engineer – Manual - Desktop Applications
description:
**Create the future of e\-Health together with us by becoming a part of our Development Center in Bangalore**
 As a leading provider of software solutions for healthcare, we operate in 19 countries and employ over 9,000 passionate professionals. Join us and become part of a dynamic, innovative environment overflowing with possibilities. Your dedication and passion will empower you to make a lasting impact.
   

  

 Together, we are shaping the future of healthcare. Become part of our mission and make a difference—for a world where knowledge saves lives!
   

  

**Your Impact**
 We are looking for a
 **QA Engineer** 
 who can execute test cases manually as well as converting them to automated test cases using C\# and Automation Tools. These are for mission\-critical Windows Desktop products. These products generate significant revenue and require robust, maintainable, and scalable test coverage.
   

  

 You will be responsible understanding the product functionality, executing manual test cases, and for eventual conversion of the test cases to automation using C\# and automation tools. Modern AI Tooling and AI Assisted development will be used in all applicable stages. You will be required to understand and comply with documentation requirements and other best practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Work closely with the development teams and own the QA activities
* Perform manual QA \- UI, functional, regression, and exploration testing on desktop applications
* Write and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios based on requirements/specifications
* Log, track, and verify defects using bug\-tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, Azure DevOps)
* Perform UI, usability, and installation/uninstallation testing for desktop applications
* Collaborate with developers and business analysts to understand requirements and edge cases
* Participate in test planning, test case reviews, and release signoffs
* Document test results and prepare test summary reports
* Extend the existing automation framework and add automated test cases
* Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines


**You Are a Good Fit for This Job If You Have:**
* 2\+ years of experience in manual QA and automation.
* Strong understanding of SDLC and STLC
* Experience writing test cases, test plans, and defect reports
* Familiarity with bug\-tracking/test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Azure DevOps, or similar)
* Good understanding of database concepts (basic SQL for data validation is a plus)
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Knowledge in C\# and .NET
* Expertise with QA tools like Playwright
* Experience in automating Windows desktop applications
* Excellent communication skills.
* Experience, or an eagerness to learn, AI\-assisted development.
* Relevant academic qualifications.


**What You Can Expect From Us**
* High Performing Team: You will be part of a close\-nit, elite team within CGM that will move fast, with accuracy and hit deadlines with confidence.
* Hybrid Work: Enjoy the flexibility of working two days per week remotely and three days on\-site at our Bangalore office.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Extensive group health and accidental insurance programs.
* Seamless Onboarding: A safe digital application process and a structured onboarding program.
* Career Growth: Various career growth opportunities and a competitive merit increment policy.
* Stable \& Resilient domain: Healthcare is a relatively stable and recession\-proof domain.


**Even if you do not meet all the requirements of this job post, we encourage you to apply!** 
 We are interested in your real\-world experience, strengths, and problem\-solving style rather than generic and theoretical assessments.
   

  

**Convinced?** 
 Submit your application now (including desired salary and earliest possible starting date). We create the future of e\-health. Become part of a significant mission.

title: Principal Eng, Disposables
description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.
   

  

 We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.
   

  

**Education Qualification**
 Bachelor’s/master’s degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent relevant technical degree.
   

  

 10 to 16years of relevant Experience in Systems \& Component level Verification \& Validation activities.
   

  

 Deep domain knowledge in design verification and validation of medical devices.
   

  

 Relevant technical testing/reliability experience in Plastic/Connectors/Products/electro\-mechanical.
   

  

 Understanding of hardware methodologies and test best practices.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
 Own and drive change control activities by ensuring accountability for all technical aspects of development, sustaining projects, and design controls.
   

  

 Lead the design and execution of R\&D studies, provide manufacturing support as needed, and contribute to product specifications.
   

  

 Drive the development, improvement, and troubleshooting of disposable manufacturing processes.
   

  

 Lead and implement changes through creative solutions, adapting to new product test methods and technologies while driving test automation to improve quality assurance and productivity in test deliverables.
   

  

 Partner with R\&D and cross\-functional teams to coordinate product integration and system testing, including automated testing.
   

  

 Plan, build, and maintain test infrastructure, including lab budget planning and management.
   

  

 Demonstrate the ability to achieve objectives and deliver multiple projects simultaneously.
   

  

 Develop and maintain effective, collaborative working relationships with internal and external stakeholders across levels and cultures.
   

  

 Lead V\&V activities to meet customer requirements, safety, regulatory, and quality expectations within committed timelines.
   

  

 Support corporate, internal, ISO, and regulatory audits by ensuring adherence to Vantive QMS requirements.
   

  

 Lead audit nonconformances or findings to closure by defining and implementing appropriate corrective actions.
   

  

 Lead and execute IQ, OQ, and PQ for equipment and instruments in accordance with QMS site policies.
   

  

 Ensure lab requirements are validated, and laboratories are qualified for intended use; coordinate shared equipment usage when needed.
   

  

 Qualify vendors and add them to the approved vendor list by coordinating with the sourcing team to ensure quick turnaround.
   

  

 Be self\-motivated with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to analyze and solve complex problems through innovative thinking and experience.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with mechanical equipment such as UTM, leak testers, torque testers, and other instruments or equipment would be an added advantage.
   

  

 Design and develop fixtures based on V\&V needs by preparing drawings and working closely with external vendors.
   

  

 Work with global cross\-functional teams to ensure completion of V\&V tasks.
   

  

 Exposure to regulatory standards, medical device manufacturing processes and procedures, RF welding, and solvent bonding would be an added benefit.
   

  

 Exposure to statistical tools such as Minitab and Six Sigma methodologies for results analysis would be an added advantage.
   

  

 Lead and execute assigned testing with minimal dependency on project owners by managing timelines, providing regular result updates, and owning final report preparation, review, sign\-off, and release.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Vantive is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. Form Link
   

  

**Recruitment Fraud Notice**
 Vantive has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Vantive employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

Job Description – PMO \+ QA Analyst
 



**Role:** 
 PMO \+ QA Analyst
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





 About the Role
 



  





 We are looking for a
 **PMO \+ QA Analyst** 
 who can work across Project Management and Quality Assurance functions. The role requires a combination of
 **QA execution, project coordination, release management, stakeholder coordination, reporting, and quality governance** 
 .
 



 The candidate will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and Business teams to ensure features and projects are delivered
 **on time and with the expected quality** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should be comfortable managing multiple workstreams, tracking project progress, identifying risks and dependencies, coordinating with stakeholders, and independently driving QA activities for assigned features/releases.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 PMO \& Project Management
 


* Track project, sprint, feature, and release timelines.
* Maintain project trackers, sprint trackers, dashboards, and action\-item trackers.
* Monitor progress against planned timelines and highlight deviations.
* Track
 **risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and blockers (RAID)** 
 .
* Coordinate with Product, Engineering, QA, and other stakeholders to ensure timely completion of activities.
* Follow up on pending tasks and ensure closure of action items.
* Coordinate sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, retrospectives, release discussions, and project meetings.
* Track feature readiness across different stages of the SDLC.
* Monitor dependencies between Product, Development, QA, vendors, and other teams.
* Prepare and circulate regular project/sprint status reports.
* Escalate risks, blockers, and timeline concerns to relevant stakeholders.
* Support planning and tracking of multiple projects/releases simultaneously.



 QA \& Quality Assurance
 


* Review
 **PRDs, user stories, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria** 
 .
* Identify requirement gaps, ambiguities, edge cases, and dependencies before development/testing.
* Prepare and review test scenarios and detailed test cases.
* Execute and coordinate
 **functional, regression, smoke, sanity, integration, and end\-to\-end testing** 
 .
* Perform API testing using tools such as
 **Postman** 
 .
* Validate UI, API responses, business rules, validations, and end\-to\-end workflows.
* Log detailed defects in JIRA with clear steps to reproduce, expected vs actual results, severity, and supporting evidence.
* Track defects through the complete lifecycle and coordinate with Development/Product teams for resolution.
* Perform defect retesting and regression after fixes.
* Validate fixes across relevant environments.
* Monitor QA progress and identify testing risks or gaps.
* Maintain QA metrics such as test execution status, defect status, open blockers, and release readiness.
* Support production issue investigation and RCA activities.
* Ensure adequate regression coverage before releases.



 Release \& Production Readiness
 


* Coordinate QA activities for planned releases.
* Track feature readiness across
 **Development, UAT, Pre\-Production, and Production** 
 environments.
* Ensure required QA activities and documentation are completed before release.
* Track test execution, open defects, blockers, and pending dependencies before release.
* Coordinate QA sign\-off/release readiness with relevant stakeholders.
* Support production deployment validation and post\-release verification.
* Track production issues and ensure appropriate RCA and closure.
* Maintain release documentation, test reports, and sign\-off records.



 Quality \& Process Improvement
 


* Identify gaps in existing QA and project execution processes.
* Recommend improvements to testing, tracking, documentation, and release processes.
* Ensure standard QA and PMO processes are followed across projects.
* Identify recurring defects, process gaps, and quality risks.
* Contribute to improving test coverage and release quality.
* Help establish and maintain project and QA metrics.
* Support implementation of quality gates and production\-readiness checks.



  





 Required Skills
 


* **1–3 years of experience** 
 in QA, PMO, Project Coordination, or a combination of these.
* Strong understanding of
 **SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, and software delivery lifecycle** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience with functional and regression testing.
* Experience in API testing using
 **Postman** 
 or similar tools.
* Good knowledge of
 **JIRA** 
 and project/task tracking.
* Strong knowledge of
 **Excel / Google Sheets** 
 and reporting.
* Good understanding of defect lifecycle and release management.
* Ability to review requirements and identify gaps.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, features, and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent documentation and follow\-up skills.



 Good to Have
 


* Knowledge of
 **SQL/MongoDB** 
 .
* Experience with automation tools such as
 **Selenium, TestNG, Karate, or REST Assured** 
 .
* Basic understanding of performance/load testing.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins.
* Experience with monitoring/logging tools such as Kibana.
* Experience working with API\-driven products.
* Experience in
 **FinTech, Banking, SaaS, or enterprise technology products** 
 .
* Understanding of production\-readiness and release\-governance processes.



 Key Competencies
 


* **Ownership:** 
 Takes responsibility for assigned features, releases, and deliverables.
* **Coordination:** 
 Effectively works with Product, Development, QA, and Business teams.
* **Attention to Detail:** 
 Identifies requirement, testing, and process gaps.
* **Communication:** 
 Clearly communicates progress, risks, blockers, and dependencies.
* **Problem Solving:** 
 Investigates issues and drives them toward resolution.
* **Planning:** 
 Can prioritize and manage multiple activities simultaneously.
* **Quality Mindset:** 
 Focuses on preventing issues rather than only identifying defects.
* **Execution:** 
 Ensures planned activities are tracked through completion.



  





 Success in This Role
 



  





 The person should be able to independently:
 



  




* Drive QA activities for assigned features/releases.
* Maintain accurate project and QA trackers.
* Identify and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies.
* Coordinate effectively with Product, Engineering, QA, and other stakeholders.
* Ensure testing and release activities are completed on schedule.
* Provide clear visibility into
 **project status, quality status, and release readiness** 
 .
* Contribute to improving the overall QA and project execution process

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field
* 8\+ years of experience in developing comprehensive test plans, test suites, and executing test cases, with a strong emphasis on database validation
* 7\+ years of experience in QA testing, with at least 5 years specifically focused on ServiceNow
* 7\+ years of experience in ensuring test traceability, linking requirements to functional deliveries
* 4\+ years of experience working in the HR, healthcare, finance, or banking domains, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively with multivendor teams
* 3\+ years of experience in automating test processes using Selenium or other open\-source automation tools
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in writing, updating, and executing SQL queries for testing purposes
* 2\+ years of experience utilizing Microsoft Azure Test Plan and test management tools
* 2\+ years of experience in managing defects, including triaging, brainstorming, retesting, and reporting
* Demonstrated experience working within Agile, hybrid\-agile, and waterfall methodologies


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ServiceNow Certified Testing Specialist (CTS)
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator
* Experience with CSM, HRSD, or other relevant ServiceNow modules
* Proven solid written and verbal communication skills
* Proven to be proactive, decisive, and action\-oriented approach to work
* Proven excellent interpersonal skills, with a collaborative and team\-oriented mindset
* Proven ability to clearly articulate requirements into comprehensive test cases and ensure thorough test coverage across different teams
* Proven ability to manage and deliver multiple projects simultaneously

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. title: QA Analyst - AI/ML
description:
**TITLE: QA ANALYST — AI/ML**
**Location** 
 : Bangalore \|
 **Work mode** 
 : Hybrid Experience: 6\+ years QA experience (required)
   

  

 About the role We’re hiring a seasoned QA Analyst to own AI/ML testing with a heavy focus on voice AI. The role requires a confident, independent thinker who will design and run hundreds of call test scenarios, document results, coordinate voice testing with US teammates, and develop/maintain automation to improve coverage and efficiency.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* 
+ Own end\-to\-end AI/voice QA process: plan tests, create and maintain test artifacts, run tests, track defects, and sign off releases.
+ Design, author, and maintain hundreds of call/call\-flow test scenarios and test matrices (currently tracked in spreadsheets).
+ Execute functional and exploratory testing of voice AI systems (IVR, conversational agents, ASR/NLU, TTS), including negative and edge\-case scenarios.
+ Develop, maintain, and extend test automation for regression and smoke suites (API, integration, and end\-to\-end voice test automation).
+ Build automated test harnesses and pipelines to validate model outputs, call flows, and telephony integrations; integrate tests into CI/CD.
+ Validate AI model outputs for correctness, safety, bias, and regressions; document behavioral drift and failure modes.
+ Coordinate and delegate voice test execution to US\-based teammates, call center agents, or third parties; manage logistics and communication.
+ Improve QA processes: identify automation candidates, increase test coverage, and optimize documentation/workflows.


**Required Qualifications**
* 
+ 6\+ years professional QA experience with demonstrable ownership of QA processes.
+ 4\+ years of hands\-on QA automation experience using Selenium or Cypress.
+ Direct experience testing AI systems, ML models, or conversational agents (voice AI experience strongly preferred).
+ Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Python for automation scripting.
+ Experience in API testing using Postman, RestAssured, or SoapUI.
+ Excellent spoken and written English \- native fluency required.
+ Strong test\-design skills, with proven ability to author large volumes of test cases and call scenarios.
+ Proven experience in QA automation: designing test frameworks, writing automated tests (API, integration, E2E), and integrating with CI/CD.
+ Comfortable owning cross\-functional communication and coordinating remote test execution with external parties.
+ Experience working with spreadsheets for large test suites; familiarity with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr) is preferred.
+ Strong analytical skills; ability to reproduce non\-deterministic AI behaviors and document them clearly.
+ Proficient in scripting/programming for automation and log analysis; familiarity with data formats (JSON, CSV).
+ Proven initiative and process\-improvement orientation.

**Senior Computer System Validation (CSV)**
**POSITION PURPOSE:**
 We are seeking a Senior Computer System Validation (CSV) Engineer to lead and manage validation activities for local R\&D business software applications used in a regulated medical device software development environment. This role is responsible for ensuring GxP and non\- GxP systems comply with regulatory requirements, data integrity and security principles, and internal quality standards across the full system lifecycle.
   

  

 This role works closely with global, cross functional teams to support compliant implementations, documentation, effective lifecycle management, and audit readiness. The ideal candidate will be a proactive leader who can drive outcomes and align with Bayer's mission and values.

* Develop, execute, and maintain validation deliverables such as user requirement specs, validation plans, test protocols, test scripts, test reports, risk assessments, and change documentation.
* Execute formal validation testing activities (UAT, IQ, OQ, PQ) for GxP relevant systems.
* Draft, review, and update SOPs and procedural documentation in compliance with GxP requirements and internal quality processes.
* Apply risk based validation approaches to ensure efficient, compliant validation activities.
* Support system lifecycle management, change control, and impact assessments for validated systems.
* Ensure compliance with 21 CFR Part 11, GxP regulation, and data integrity expectations.
* Support and coordinate user access management and administrative activities for validated tools.
* Manage tool related service (new requests, project efforts, and break\-fix) and administration requests via ServiceNow.
* Collaborate closely with Software Quality Management, IT, Engineering, and other stakeholders to ensure audit readiness.
* Support internal and external audits, access reviews, and inspections by providing validation evidence and subject matter expertise.
* Participate in deviation management, CAPA activities, and continuous improvement initiatives related to validated systems.

title: Senior QA Engineer - AI
description:
**About The Company**
 At Delta, we are reimagining and rebuilding the financial system. Join our team to make a positive impact on the future of finance.
   

  

 🎯 Mission Driven: Re\-imagine and rebuild the future of finance.
   

  

 💡 Most innovative cryptocurrency derivatives exchange. With a daily traded volume of
 **\~$ 10 billion** 
 , and increasing. Delta is bigger than all the Indian crypto exchanges combined.
   

  

 📈 Offer the widest range of derivative products and have been serving traders all over the globe since 2018 and growing fast.
   

  

 💪🏻 The founding team is comprised of IIT and ISB graduates. Business co\-founders have previously worked with Citibank, UBS and GIC; and our tech co\-founder is a serial entrepreneur who previously co\-founded TinyOwl and Housing.com.
   

  

 💰 Funded by top crypto funds (Sino Global Capital, CoinFund, Gumi Cryptos) and crypto projects (Aave and Kyber Network).
   

  

**Senior QA Engineer \- AI**
**🎯 Role Overview**
 Delta operates three AI products used by live traders: a customer support chatbot, an API Copilot that generates and executes trading scripts, and an MCP server. This role owns the quality of those products and is responsible for measuring it objectively.
   

  

 Testing probabilistic systems differs fundamentally from testing deterministic ones. The same input produces different output on every run, an incorrect answer can be entirely fluent, and a prompt change in one flow can degrade another without any visible signal. The core of this role is establishing what correct means for these systems, building the datasets and scoring that measure it, and operating the release gate that prevents a regression from reaching customers.
   

  

 This is an emerging discipline with no established playbook. We are defining the methodology as we build it, and the role carries a high degree of autonomy and ownership.
   

  

**🔬 What Sets This Role Apart**
 Most QA roles that mention AI mean using AI to do testing faster: generating test cases from a PRD, healing flaky selectors, exploring an app with an agent. Those are useful and we do them.
   

  

 This role is the other thing. The system under test is itself an AI, and the hard problem is deciding whether its output is correct when the same question produces a different answer every time and a wrong answer reads as convincingly as a right one. That means building evaluation datasets, defining what correct looks like, scoring against it, and defending a number that decides whether a release ships.
   

  

 If you have spent time on the second problem, this role is built for you.
   

  

**🛠 Key Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain golden datasets for our AI products, trace mined from production or generated, and verified against a documented source of truth.
* Design layered scoring for AI outputs: deterministic rules where behaviour can be asserted, and model\-graded evaluation where it cannot.
* Manage evaluation runs end to end: schedule and execute them against release candidates, compare results against prior baselines, and triage failures into product defects, incorrect expectations, and platform issues.
* Own and operate the release gate that determines whether a prompt or model change is approved for production.
* Identify failure modes ahead of customers, including hallucination, incorrect tool selection, loss of context across conversation turns, and PII exposure.
* Investigate production traces to distinguish retrieval failures from generation failures from tool failures.
* Convert findings into actionable engineering evidence and into permanent regression coverage.
* Define and report quality metrics for AI surfaces, and drive improvement against them.


**✅ Requirements**
*Non\-negotiable*
* At least 1 year owning quality for AI products in a lead or primary\-owner capacity. This includes chatbots and conversational assistants, code or content generation products, and agentic systems. You should have worked directly with prompts, tool and function schemas, and model behaviour, rather than testing around them.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience building or operating an evaluation harness for an AI system, whether in\-house or using a framework such as DeepEval, RAGAS or Promptfoo. You should be able to describe what the harness measured, the results it produced, and the decisions those results informed.


*Also required*
* 4\-6 years of QA / SDET experience.
* Working proficiency in Python. Our evaluation platform, trace analysis and internal tooling are Python\-based.
* Ability to analyse traces and tool calls, using observability tooling such as Opik, Langfuse or LangSmith or an equivalent, to determine root cause rather than reporting the symptom.
* Strong API testing experience. The majority of the surface under test is API\-level.
* Sufficient engineering ability to build your own tooling and automation.
* Clear written communication. Findings must be documented in a form engineering can act on directly.


*Bonus*
* Experience with trading or exchange platforms, including familiarity with futures and options, crypto derivatives, margin, or settlement flows. Domain knowledge can be picked up on the job, but arriving with it shortens the ramp considerably.


**🚀 Why Join Us?**
* Play a pivotal role in shaping the regulatory landscape for digital assets and Web3 in India.
* Work directly with founders and senior leadership on high\-impact strategic initiatives.
* Be part of a mission\-driven, fast\-growing organisation at the forefront of financial innovation.
* Competitive compensation, leadership exposure, and significant growth opportunities.
